contexts.text: Spirits above the head. AC 1380.
The inward man is above the rational.
Divine things are above the understanding of human rational truth.
What is Divine is above all understanding and thought... AC 2533:2. Explained. AC 5110:2.
Although it seems to him that he is rational above all others.
That is below to the infernals which to the celestials is above, and that is above to the infernals which to the celestials is below.
What is spiritual and celestial is within or above nature. HH 116.
To set over = dominion.
Over = serving and ministering.
Such persons place blessedness in being over the Angels.
To elevate themselves above others...
The Divine truth that proceeds immediately is above all angelic understanding. AC 8443:2.
The first two degrees of Divine Truth are above the Heavens.
Man is so created that he can look upwards, or above himself, and also downwards, or below himself. Explained.
Hence it is that Heaven appears above, and Hell below.
Everything inward is there presented to view representatively as above, and what is outward as below. References.
The Divine regarded in itself is above the Heavens...
The Divine above the Heavens is Divine Good itself.
Their inward man is closed above and open below. See Close.
Above = within. AC 9961. AR 900, Explained. AE 595, Explained.
The Lord Himself is above the Heavens... His Divine above the Heavens cannot be represented, because it is infinite... AC 9956. AC 10579:7.
If the higher things of the mind are closed above...
The Lord appears above Heaven as a sun, but the truth is He is in it...
The Lord being above the Heavens as a sun does not speak to the Angels thence, but flows in.
These ancient Heavens are above the Christian Heaven.
This limbus is below with those who come into Heaven and what is spiritual is above, but with those who come into Hell the limbus is above and what is spiritual below.
They who are above see and perceive all things below, but they who are below perceive and see nothing of the things above, that is, within.
That they who are above give light to those who are below, when they agree.
